title: Neuroepo multisession
description: Resting-state EEG recorded from 25 patients with Parkinson's disease enrolled in a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial of Neuroepo, an erythropoietin formulation with low sialic acid content. Participants received Neuroepo (n=15) or placebo (n=10), and EEG was recorded before and six months after administration. Raw data are provided in EEG-BIDS format to support assessment of qualitative and quantitative EEG (source-level) biomarkers of neuroprotection.
methods_description: Resting-state EEG was recorded before and six months after drug administration. Two experts rated EEG abnormalities on a Likert-type scale, analyzed with a multivariate item response theory approach. Source-level quantitative EEG was computed with VARETA and co-registered to the MNI atlas. Statistics used permutation tests and surfstat contrasts with Bonferroni correction.
